findings: processFolderDetails always excludes favorites from system/user categories, but adds their own category only when showFavorites is true. Disabling that setting therefore hides favorite folders entirely from category-based selectAll.
Recursive select, deselect, unselect and permanent-sort expansion use raw startsWith without a path-component boundary, including sibling names such as /Photos-old under /Photos.

initializeSelection launches asynchronously after the observer receives folders and marks initialization complete immediately; subsequent completion can overwrite user selection. Favorites are always unioned into selection even in NONE mode.

Initial loading has no catch/finally around repository and preference calls; failure can leave initial-load/scanning state. The ongoing processing catch updates an error and then completes the collector without restart.

Rename updates repository and preferences after filesystem success without a shared transaction or catch, and does not rewrite current selected/context/recursive path sets. Partial completion is possible.

Move dialog excludes only exact source path, leaving descendant destinations available. Confirmation performs no further descendant check before invoking the previously reviewed helper. No filesystem move was executed.

Permanent-sort preference entries are written one at a time before cache removal; interruption can persist a partial set. Recursively selected roots are not cleaned when hidden paths are removed from selection.

controls.kind: independent Python transcription of filtering predicates; not Kotlin execution
